Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.

Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
Theory and practice are two sides of a coin, <name>. Remember this.

Do my eyes deceive me? I haven't seen a drop of Thunder Applejack in months!
This should put a smile on the troops' faces. You have my thanks, <class>!
This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, <class>. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.
The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.

So, you took down Elmpaw? Very impressive, <name>!

Let me give you something in return for your trophy - I know a few collectors who will pay quite well to have this on their mantle once I've prepared it.
